Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Aluminum
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of aluminum by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for aluminum. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-134
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_4 when using tools use this path.

For that, answer with: "Final Answer: <your answer>". It is very important to follow this format.

4. Analyze the results to get the bulk modulus

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_4/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Al.data

# EAM potential for Al
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al_nist.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Setup for elastic constant calculation
variable delta equal 1.0e-6
variable deltaxy equal ${delta}
variable deltaxz equal ${delta}
variable deltayz equal ${delta}

# Store initial box dimensions
variable tmp equal lx
variable lx0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal ly
variable ly0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal lz
variable lz0 equal ${tmp}

# Define deformation matrix
variable xx equal 1.0+${delta}
variable yy equal 1.0+${delta}
variable zz equal 1.0+${delta}

# Calculate C11
change_box all x scale ${xx} y scale 1.0 z scale 1.0 remap
run 0
variable C11 equal -((pxx-pxx0)/(${delta}))

# Calculate C12
variable C12 equal -((pyy-pyy0)/(${delta}))

# Calculate C13
variable C13 equal -((pzz-pzz0)/(${delta}))

# Reset box
change_box all x scale 1.0 y scale 1.0 z scale 1.0 remap

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal (${C11}+2.0*${C12})/3.0

print "Bulk modulus = ${B} GPa""}

# Initialization
units metal

boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Al.data

# EAM potential for Al
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al_nist.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Store initial volume and pressure
variable V0 equal vol
variable P0 equal press

# Apply small volume change

variable V1 equal ${V0}*(1.0+${dV})
change_box all volume ${V1} uniform remap
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
variable P1 equal press

# Calculate bulk modulus
# B = -V(dP/dV) ≈ -V0(P1-P0)/dV
variable B equal -${V0}*(${P1}-${P0})/${dV}

print "Bulk modulus = ${B} GPa""}
